Title: Private link for Azure SQL Data Sync on Azure SQL Database now in public preview

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Sync is a service built on Azure SQL Database that enables you to synchronize the data you select bi-directionally across multiple databases, both on-premises and in the cloud. Now in public preview, private link for SQL Data Sync enables you to establish a secure connection over a service managed private endpoint to connect the SQL Data Sync service to the hub and the member databases during the data synchronization process. This feature requires both the member and hub databases to be hosted in Azure and in the same cloud type (e.g. both in public cloud or both in government cloud). Existing SQL Data Sync groups can be updated to have this feature enabled.

Learn more.
